linkedin.content:
Plugin screenshots are easy to overread.

Before trying a routing plugin on a real board, I prefer a small fixture that makes failure cases visible: 0°, 45°, 90°, and 135° corners, three track widths, both copper layers, and a via. Run DRC before and after, and keep the exact settings beside the images.

I built that fixture for KiCad 10 and made the board, manifest, renders, and clean baseline public. It does not prove that any third-party plugin works; it gives maintainers a repeatable place to test one.

For a maintainer who wants the sweep done, I’m also offering one fixed USD 400 evaluation for one authorized plugin version and up to four presets. No customer board or code repair; fit check and written scope first.
